'''Kashyyyk wheat flour''' was a type of [[Flour/Legends|flour]] that despite its name was not actually made from [[Wheat/Legends|wheat]].<ref name="Between the Worlds" /> The flour did share its name with the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] served [[wasaka berry pie]] that was made with a Kashyyyk wheat flour crust at his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> By [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="LivingForce Date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the Invasion of Naboo, an event that is dated to 32 BBY by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> [[Darkside (space station)|Darkside]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], had several [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]] bags of Kashyyyk wheat flour stored in its kitchen's freezer.<ref name="Between the Worlds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kashyyyk wheat flour was first mentioned in "[[Between the Worlds: MidWorld]]," the second [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] adventure in the [[Between the Worlds trilogy]]. The adventure was written by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and released by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[April]] [[2001]] as part of its [[RPGA|Role Playing Game Association]].<ref name="Between the Worlds" />
